name: Foodie Match Travel
description_tr: Foodie Match Travel ile lezzetli bir dünya turuna çıkın! Renkli eşleştirme-3 bulmacalarını çözün, farklı şehirleri keşfedin, yerel lezzetleri tanıyın ve eğlenceli bir maceraya katılın.
title_en: A Delicious Journey Around the World
description_en: Explore the world through delicious match-3 puzzles! Discover iconic cities, match local dishes, complete exciting levels, and enjoy a colorful culinary adventure in Foodie Match Travel.
title_de: Eine köstliche Reise um die Welt
description_de: Entdecke die Welt mit köstlichen Match-3-Rätseln! Reise durch berühmte Städte, kombiniere lokale Spezialitäten, meistere spannende Level und erlebe ein farbenfrohes kulinarisches Abenteuer.

name: CYTOON
description_tr: Car Tycoon: Merge & Race artık Google Play'de! Araçları birleştirin, garajınızı geliştirin ve kendi yarış imparatorluğunuzu kurun. Hemen indirerek maceraya katılın!
title_en: Car Tycoon: Merge & Race Is Now Available!
description_en: Car Tycoon: Merge & Race is now available on Google Play! Merge cars, upgrade your garage, and build your own racing empire. Download now and start your journey!
title_de: Car Tycoon: Merge & Race ist jetzt verfügbar!
description_de: Car Tycoon: Merge & Race ist jetzt bei Google Play erhältlich! Kombiniere Autos, verbessere deine Garage und baue dein eigenes Rennimperium auf. Lade das Spiel jetzt herunter und starte dein Abenteuer!
title_ko: Car Tycoon: Merge & Race 정식 출시!
description_ko: Car Tycoon: Merge & Race가 Google Play에 출시되었습니다! 자동차를 합치고 차고를 업그레이드하며 나만의 레이싱 제국을 건설해 보세요. 지금 다운로드하고 새로운 모험을 시작하세요!
title_pt: Car Tycoon: Merge & Race já está disponível!
description_pt: Car Tycoon: Merge & Race já está disponível no Google Play! Combine carros, melhore sua garagem e construa seu próprio império de corridas. Baixe agora e comece sua aventura!
title_zh-CN: Car Tycoon: Merge & Race 正式上线！
description_zh-CN: Car Tycoon: Merge & Race 现已正式登陆 Google Play！合并汽车、升级车库，打造属于自己的赛车帝国。立即下载，开启精彩的赛车之旅！
title_zh-TW: Car Tycoon: Merge & Race 正式上線！
description_zh-TW: Car Tycoon: Merge & Race 現已正式登上 Google Play！合併汽車、升級車庫，打造專屬於你的賽車帝國。立即下載，展開精彩的賽車旅程！
